verdict.rationale: The x402 Bazaar is a public, keyless catalog of payment-gated services. Buyers can search it with network, asset, scheme and price filters, through an OpenAPI client or the Bazaar MCP server. A runtime probe confirmed it returns machine-readable listings with USDC amounts, asset contracts, network, scheme and timeouts. However, it covers only x402 pay-per-request endpoints, not general products, and offer data is limited to payment terms. Missing for 10: availability/stock fields (only implicit 30-day delisting), product variants (only multiple accepted payment options), explicit checkout links beyond the resource endpoint itself, coverage of non-x402 products and services.
